meta.clustered: 6 families with replacement, then 5 seeds within each drawn family with replacement; independent within-family draws for repeated families (summarize_all.boot(cluster=True) rng order)
meta.statistic: pooled mean / p99 FCT over the concatenated flows of the sampled cells; censored at the horizon
meta.contrast: FCT(strategy) - FCT(reference), ticks and %; positive = strategy slower
meta.verdict: tick CI: '+' entire CI > 0, '-' entire CI < 0, '0' includes 0; verdict_pct on the % CI
